stemMd: No ceramic cup in a collection is cracked. Some blue cups in the collection are cracked. What must follow?

options.label: E
options.textMd: Some blue cups are not ceramic.

explanationMd: The cracked blue cups exist. Because ceramic cups cannot be cracked under the first premise, those particular blue cups must be nonceramic. The conclusion applies to some blue cups, not necessarily all of them.

distractorRationale.c: Only the cracked blue cups are known to be nonceramic.
distractorRationale.b: The premises do not describe all nonceramic cups.
distractorRationale.d: This directly contradicts the first premise.
distractorRationale.a: The second premise says some, not all.
